name: hermes-studiotwin
description: StudioTwin creative suite for Hermes: images, environment maps, worlds, PBR materials, meshes, rigs, motion, audio and Concepts, powered only by StudioTwin. A bundled local gateway mediates every hosted result and keeps a single-use operation ledger before any paid call. In Hermes Desktop: a StudioTwin page (Library, Jobs, Concepts, Create), inline asset cards, credit and active-job chips.

api_key.label: StudioTwin API key
api_key.description: Used only by the local StudioTwin gateway and Desktop backend; never shown to the model or the browser. Saving it restarts the StudioTwin tools.

endpoint.label: StudioTwin environment
endpoint.description: Staging is the development default. Production stays disabled until it is certified. Expert uses the URL and separate key below.

expert_url.label: Expert endpoint URL
expert_url.description: HTTPS only, used when the environment is Expert. It never receives the staging or production key.

expert_url_confirmed.label: I confirm this expert endpoint
expert_url_confirmed.description: The gateway refuses an expert endpoint until you confirm it here.

expert_api_key.label: Expert endpoint API key
expert_api_key.description: Separate credential for the expert endpoint. It is never filled in from the main API key.

spend_guard_credits.label: Spend guard per chat (credits)
spend_guard_credits.description: Estimated credits one chat may reserve before the gateway stops paid calls. This is a local guard on estimates, not a server-enforced maximum.

unattended_max_credits.label: Unattended spend (credits)
unattended_max_credits.description: Cron and other headless runs. Zero means no paid StudioTwin calls without you present.

poll_cadence.label: Job refresh cadence
poll_cadence.description: Standard refreshes active jobs at 3 s, then 10 s, then 30 s. Relaxed refreshes less often.

inline_cards.label: Inline asset cards in chat
inline_cards.description: Desktop: render StudioTwin results as interactive cards. Off keeps the built-in players.

webgl_limit.label: Live 3D viewers
webgl_limit.description: Desktop: most WebGL viewers kept live at once. Others show thumbnails.

blender_handoff.label: Blender hand-off
blender_handoff.description: Ask before writing a new Blender file from a StudioTwin asset; it never edits an open scene. Never hides the offer.

blender_path.label: Blender executable
blender_path.description: Full path to Blender. Empty finds it on PATH or in the usual install folders.

local_import_roots.label: Project folders
local_import_roots.description: Absolute folders the backend may read local media from, in addition to its own data folder.

cache_quota_mb.label: Media cache size (MB)
cache_quota_mb.description: Unpinned downloaded media beyond this size, or older than 30 days, is removed first.
